meta.title: Accruals: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as a Finance Controller on the Growth-plan tenant
Open and use Accruals to compute received-but-not-invoiced accrual liability
Repeat the same Accruals workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and compare availability
Switch or otherwise access tenants differentiated by Growth versus Enterprise plan
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a Finance Controller on the Growth-plan tenant; Open and use Accruals to compute received-but-not-invoiced accrual liability; Repeat the same Accruals workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and compare availability; Switch or otherwise access tenants differentiated by Growth versus Enterprise plan

args.need: sign in as the Finance Controller, verify Accruals is absent or refused on the Growth-plan tenant, then repeat the same workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify Accruals is available and computes accrual liability

steps.note: No catalog step can access the Accruals capability, authenticate as the Finance Controller, or compare tenant plans.
Final assertion that the tester's resulting screen remains usable without an application error; this does not verify Accruals availability.
